author: TeIq
content: Backend implementation complete. POST /api/bulk-actions accepts {subject_ids: Vec, body: SubmitAction}, validates body once, applies per-subject with PromiseSettled-style succeeded/failed split. Cap at 50 subjects/batch (above that → use pattern-actions). Emit-shaped kinds (Label/Takedown) honour the signing-key precondition. 3 integration tests pass (3-subject batch, empty rejection, oversize rejection). Frontend multi-select UI tracked as follow-up #196.
